sourceFacts: Squeeze Conv/ReLU runs before both independent expand paths.
All three Conv use bias=True; no BN, pooling or residual.
Two expanded tensors concatenate in 1x1 then3x3 order;128 channels.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
